articles.summary: Edgewise Therapeutics, Inc. (Nasdaq: EWTX), a leading clinical-stage cardiovascular biopharmaceutical company, today reported financial results for the third quarter of 2026 and recent business highlights. "Our third quarter reflects continued execution across both cardiovascular programs," said Kevin Koch, Ph.D., President and Chief Executive Officer of Edgewise. "In HCM, positive CIRRUS-HCM Part D results and our JCI Insight publication reinforce the differentiated profile of EDG-7500, and we expect to initiate our Phase 3 trial by year-end 2026. In parallel, we dosed our first patient in the Phase 2 EQUINOX-HFpEF trial of EDG-15400, our selective cardiac sarcomere modulator designed to address impaired cardiac relaxation in HFpEF."
